acceptanceCriteria: Exactly eight distinct apology variants are produced.
Every variant has one serious header, one legal opener, two or three confessions, and one signoff.
Every variant cites one or more exact research.json strings in evidenceRefs.
Every confession reframes a supported benefit or buyer moment as fake harm.
No two variants use the same angle, opener, or confession.
No generic praise, hype, invented numbers, guarantees, URLs, hashtags, or emojis appear.
No confession enters healthcare, insurance, physical safety, legal, breach, crisis, or vulnerable-person territory.
All eight PNGs are unique and exactly 1080 x 1350.
All text and logos are readable without clipping or overflow.
manualReview: Does the header and opener briefly look like a real corporate statement?
Does each confession contain a specific product truth instead of a generic brag?
Can every confession be traced to research.json?
Are all eight jokes meaningfully different?
Did the renderer keep every word fully visible?
